objective_pressure_profile: rubric-derived label freeze on full public split

biggest_risks: the full-public-split objective label could still be shortcut-satisfiable from source-family or topic cues, so the lexical gate must run before any probe claim
prompt-side theory_identity remains a diagnostic-only track until an alias family beats the stronger held-out text baselines
response-side action labels on generated text can leak by construction because the response text itself contains the advocated action
MoReBench theory split contains 150 rows but only 30 unique dilemma texts, so row-count intuition can overstate real dilemma diversity
response-side experiments still require a generate-annotate-validate-freeze gate plus stronger action-equivalence scoring than naive response clustering
some prompt confound families are still unmaterialized
next_step: freeze a full-public-split rubric-derived objective_pressure_profile label and run the prompt-side lexical gate plus source-family-aware readout before any new MoReBench response-side capture
